description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the Bell Star Dlx Mips Solid-Tc-3 is crafted for daily urban navigators conquering dense traffic. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1334g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~85 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.06 impact standards. introduction: Positioned in Bell's Full Face lineup, the bell_star_dlx_mips_solid-tc-3 brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Bell Star Dlx Mips Solid-Tc-3 represents Bell's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~85 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Bell Star Dlx Mips Solid-Tc-3 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
